Oneliner

Hosted payload rideshare mission. LoRaWAN IoT network in space. Payloads from Lacuna Space and Blink Astro.
Results

BTD-1 demonstration for Blink Astro concluded in September 2019 with primary goals achieved.
Notes

Payloads from Lacuna Space and Blink Astro. Released into wrong and lower orbit. BTD-1 demonstration concluded in September 2019.
